newsitem.title: GREECE: Sigma Sec places 1.33 mln Lavipharm at 2,500 drs.
newsitem.headline: Sigma Sec places 1.33 mln Lavipharm at 2,500 drs.

text.p: A total of 1,330,963 shares of Greek pharmaceuticals and cosmetics firm Lavipharm were placed at 2,500 drachmas with foreign institutional investors on Friday, block trade co-ordinator Sigma Securities told Reuters.
"The block was 99 percent placed with foreign institutional investors," said Carina Pournara, director of Sigma Securities' trading and sales.
Except for two local institutional portfolios, the shares were placed abroad, she added.
A part of the block which was entirely executed by Sigma Securities was placed by SBC Warburg.
The shares were placed ex-rights. Those rights will be fully exercised by Athanasios Lavidas, Lavipharm's main shareholder.
Lavipharm is in the midst of a 4-for-10 rights issue at 1,900 drachmas to raise 6.46 billion drachmas.

Proceeds will be used to complete capital investments for transdermal drug production and storage facilities, to finance research and development of transdermal and osmotic technology and to retire bank debt and finance acquisitions. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
